claims.claim: On November 12, 2026, Louisiana Attorney General Liz Murrill sued prediction-market operators in the 21st Judicial District Court for Tangipahoa Parish, and Judge Jeffrey Johnson signed an ex parte temporary restraining order at 3:48 p.m.

claims.supporting_quote: The lawsuit was filed on November 12 in the 21st Judicial District Court for Tangipahoa Parish.

claims.claim: The Louisiana order expires after 10 days unless extended, and a preliminary-injunction hearing is set for November 30.

claims.claim: A 2024 arXiv paper found a V-shaped relationship between base-rate neglect and worst-case aggregation regret, with intermediate lambda sometimes beating perfect Bayesian updating.
claims.episode_span: An intermediate lambda, short of one, can produce lower worst-case regret than perfect posteriors.
claims.source_title: The Surprising Benefits of Base Rate Neglect in Robust Aggregation
claims.supporting_quote: predictions with an intermediate incorporating degree of base rate λ<1 can counter-intuitively lead to lower regret than perfect Bayesian posteriors with λ=1.

claims.claim: Lundin explorers underestimated geological probability of success and overestimated success-case volumes on 25 Norwegian Continental Shelf wells from 2011 to 2015 relative to base rates.
claims.episode_span: Lundin explorers consistently and significantly underestimated geological probability of success and overestimated success-case volumes
claims.source_title: Integrate instead of ignoring: Base rate neglect as a common fallacy of petroleum explorers
claims.supporting_quote: Lundin explorers consistently and significantly underestimated the geological POS and overestimated the success case volumes relative to the available base rate information
